_doc: Path areas that must name the reference app they follow (docs/readers/integration-standard.md section 3). To cover a new area add one group: paths are regexes tested against each changed path (case-insensitive); apps are the allowed references (keys of REFERENCE_APPS in rules.mjs). A PR touching several groups needs an allowed app for each. 'Reference: none (<reason>)' needs a reason of at least 20 characters. 'dirs' lists the directories that carry a generated AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (node scripts/merge-gates/reference-docs.mjs --write regenerates them; the merge-gates test fails when they drift). 'hint' says which files in a shared directory belong to the group.
